CHAPTER 1 · ITEM 05 / 10

Scarcity, choices and opportunity cost

Marginal reasoning邊際決策

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Apply marginal reasoning: take an additional action when its marginal benefit exceeds its marginal cost, and identify the relevant margin in a numerical question.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

邊際是額外一單位的變化。下一單位的收益高於成本就值得；總收益或平均收益不足以決定是否多做一單位。

Marginal means additional. Take the next unit when its extra benefit exceeds its extra cost. Total or average benefits cannot by themselves determine whether one more unit is worthwhile.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A third study hour adds 8 expected marks and costs leisure valued at 5 mark-equivalents. Extra net gain = 3, so study that hour. 第三小時額外淨收益為 3。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

An extra unit brings $12 revenue and $15 additional cost. Should output increase? 多做一件是否值得？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
